lines: +    // Only limit depth in already-shallow repositories; otherwise --depth would turn a full clone into a shallow one.

content.text:
I changed `gitDiff` in `packages/playwright/src/plugins/gitCommitInfoPlugin.ts` so it no longer turns a full clone into a shallow one. I haven't built or run it.

The PR-base fetch now runs `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` first. It adds `--depth=1` only when the repository is already shallow. In a complete clone, the fetch runs without a depth limit, so history stays intact. The diff against the base is still captured as before.

A full clone fetching the base commit without a depth limit may download more objects than before. I didn't use a separate object store, which the reporter also suggested.
